value.title: Anno – Spise og Drikke
value.main_text_excerpt:
Midt i hjertet av Ålesund
Velkommen til Anno Spise & Drikke – en restaurant ved Brosundet hvor gode smaker, hyggelig atmosfære og ekte matglede står i sentrum.
Hos oss får du alt fra steinovnsbakt pizza til smakfulle retter inspirert av det franske og italienske kjøkken. Enten du kommer innom for en rask lunsj eller en lang middag, sørger vi til for en god opplevelse – hver gang.
Et sted å samles
Anno ligger på Apotekertorget, i et av Ålesunds mest sjarmerende områder. Her har det vært liv og aktivitet siden 1907, og stedet har lenge vært et naturlig samlingspunkt i byen.
I dag er vi stolte av å videreføre denne tradisjonen – med fokus på god service, varme omgivelser og mat som får deg til å komme tilbake
Perfekt for små og store anledninger
Planlegger du en samling med kolleger, venner eller familie? Vi tilbyr chambre séparée «Hylla» – et lyst og innbydende rom med egen balkong og utsikt mot Brosundet.
Her er det plass til opptil 35 personer, og mulighet for å skape en mer privat og skreddersydd opplevelse.
Smaker som trekker deg tilbake
Menyen vår kombinerer klassiske og moderne retter, med tydelig inspirasjon fra det franske og italienske kjøkken. Vi bruker sesongens råvarer og legger vekt på gode teknikker og rene smaker.
Samtidig holder vi fast ved våre mest populære retter – favoritter mange av våre gjester vender tilbake til, år etter år.

external_observations.evidence_span: ANNO SØKER Dyktig Pizzaiolo  | ANNO | ÅLESUND, ÅLESUND

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Anno Restaurant Google profile: rating 4.2/5, 1166 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
One of the best fish soups I ever tasted. Don’t leave this restaurant without eating it.

Pizza is really good for Scandinavian standards, unfortunately under average for real pizza standards.

Linguini with mushrooms are ok.

5 stars for soup, 3 stars for the rest.

Let this restaurant not be number one choice while visiting Alesund, but still among best five.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
This restaurant didn’t do it for me. Portions were minuscule and after having two dishes (duck starter and cod main) I feel I just had a starter, good for diet I guess. The food wasn’t bad but also wasn’t great, missed the wow factor. I didn’t order dessert based on the impression the rest of the food left, even though I was hungry enough to eat three of them.

It also felt a tad expensive compared to other better restaurants we’ve been to in this trip in Norway.

One great thing about it is that they give tap water for the table. It’s nice they don’t force you to order drinks.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
We had lunch in this restaurant and we liked the bacalao so much that we decided to repeat again. However, the second time the service wasn’t so good, we were waiting a long time to order and it was a bit caothic.
Besides, there was a problem with tap water in the city, so we ordered mineral water instead. However, we saw the waiter full the bottle in from a big jug and the taste was quite weird. I doubt it was “mineral”.
The food is quite good but the service should be improved.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Get the codfish plate. The fish has Superior level quality. The kind you get in Lisbon. Snowy white meat and perfectly cooked as well.

Top shelf stuff 👍

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Was hungry for a pizza and my AirBnb host suggested this place. Was not disappointed. Nice zesty sauce and great blend of flavors on the pizza. Crust was perfect. And the location was central to Ålesund. Three stars for service since I sat myself, got my own water refills, and bussed my table.

external_observations.evidence_span: Anno Restaurant is rated 4.2/5 from 1166 Google reviews.
